onset: 2026-03-17T09:31:00.000Z
The retry_queue_depth metric in metrics/callbacks.csv shows a dramatic increase starting at 09:31 with a jump from 3 at 09:30 to 16 at 09:31, then rapidly escalating to a max of 495 by 09:56, indicating a backlog buildup. Concurrently, delivered_per_min dropped sharply from 44-50 range to as low as 1 by 09:59, showing delivery issues. The error_rate in metrics/http.csv also increased from a baseline of ~0.0024 to a peak of 0.0081, indicating more errors. Other metrics like p50_ms, p95_ms, and rps remained relatively stable, suggesting the incident is not due to general HTTP service degradation but specific to callback delivery and retry queue processing. The onset is pinpointed at 09:31 when the retry queue depth first surged significantly.
